# Extinction label sensitivity (generated by scripts/label_sensitivity.py)

Variants: A = from the extinction diameter (used, ADR-018); B = from 'Test end', Disruption excluded; C = from 'Test end', Disruption counted as no extinction. Grouped CV, 3 seeds, all extinction models.

Rule fixed before running: the extinction conclusions are robust if, for both B and C, (1) the mean grouped-CV AUC of the interface model (hybrid logistic) differs from A by <= 0.05, (2) the refitted interface model's P(extinction) does not rise with O2 on the 8-case grid (as in stage 6), and (3) the directions behind insights S3 / S4 hold: P(extinction) at O2 0.30 is below P at O2 0.15 (methanol and heptane, 1 atm, 3 mm).
